text:
anika_infra: Hey team — heads up, we ran into a quota wall when provisioning load balancers for the new Dedicated fleet in prod-account (us-west-2). Need increases for ALB/NLB target groups and VPCE/private endpoints.

jamie_dev: Which specific quotas are we hitting? target-groups per ALB? target-groups per region? VPCEs per VPC?

anika_infra: Short list from the error logs:
- ALB: exceeds target groups attached to load balancer (we're creating one ALB per deployment and multiple target groups for model variants).
- NLB: running into max listeners/target groups for the NLBs we use for private TCP endpoints.
- Interface VPC Endpoints (aws - VPCE): approaching account limit for us-west-2 (we need more private endpoints for model control plane + metrics).

ryan_sre: Can you paste the exact error messages? we should include them in the support ticket. Also need a count: current usage vs requested quota.

anika_infra: Error snippets: 
```
Error: Unable to attach target group to load balancer: quotaExceeded: Maximum number of target groups attached to load balancer exceeded
Status Code: 400
```
and
```
ClientError: Interface endpoint limit reached for VPC vpc-0abc1234
```
Current counts: ALBs with >12 target groups each (default config 50 target groups per ALB but we have many services), 38 VPCEs in us-west-2 (soft limit 50).

jamie_dev: Requesting increases to: ALB target-groups per ALB -> 200, NLB listeners/target groups -> 200, Interface VPCEs per region -> 200. Is 200 reasonable? Any objections?

anika_infra: 200 is our conservative ask to cover current rollout + projected growth for next 6 months. We can lower if finance balks.

maria_cloud: Need cost & blast radius notes before I sign off to open a support case:
- Why 200 vs 100
- Which accounts/regions (prod-account us-west-2 and eu-west-1)
- Rollback/mitigation plan if quotas granted incorrectly

anika_infra: Replying inline:
- Why 200: each Dedicated deployment creates multiple target groups per model variant + canary. We estimate 6 target groups per deployment * 20 deployments concurrently = 120 baseline, + buffer for infra pipelines = 200.
- Accounts/regions: prod-account (us-west-2) primary, eu-west-1 mirror.
- Rollback: we will consolidate target groups via shared target groups for identical variant configs, and move non-critical endpoints to shared NLBs. Also put a hard cap in the provisioning pipeline to avoid runaway creation.

alex_finance: Rough monthly cost impact from increasing per-account quotas is minimal (quotas themselves free), but operational risk increases. If this triggers more infra we should cap creation via Terraform and policy.

deploy-bot: Deployment blocked: create-load-balancer failed for stack redwood-dedicated-acme-usw2 (see thread).

ryan_sre: OK — next actions:
1) anika, prepare a short support request payload we can paste into AWS Support + Service Quotas: include exact account IDs, default/current usage, desired limit, region, business rationale, and links to architecture doc.
2) jamie, open a Jira ticket to track and attach cost approval from finance (maria/alex).
3) I'll pre-authorize a temporary workaround: move 2 non-critical deployments to shared ALB to unblock the immediate rollout.

anika_infra: Working draft for AWS Service Quotas request (feel free to copy):
```
Service: Elastic Load Balancing (elasticloadbalancing)
Region: us-west-2
Account ID: 123456789012
Quota: Target groups per load balancer (L-XXXXXX)
Current: 50
Requested: 200
Reason: Provisioning Dedicated inference clusters for new customer. Each deployment uses multiple model variant target groups (avg 6). We need headroom for concurrent deployments, canary rollouts, and short-term burst during onboarding. Mitigation: consolidated TG plan and hard caps in provisioning pipeline.
```
Also request:
```
Service: EC2 (vpc-endpoints)
Quota: Interface VPC endpoints per Region
Current: 50
Requested: 200
Reason: Private endpoints for control plane, metrics, and private model RPCs across Dedicated nodes.
```

jamie_dev: I'll create the Jira now: INFRA-1289 and link the aws support case when it's opened.

maria_cloud: Approve opening support case once INFRA-1289 has the cost note + architecture link. Please tag me.

anika_infra: Filed request to AWS support (case 1234567890) and Service Quotas request submitted. Cloud-aws-bot shows a pending change: request-id sq-req-0a1b2c.

cloud-aws-bot: Service Quotas request sq-req-0a1b2c — status PENDING. Expected latency: 2-7 business days.

ryan_sre: Thx. In parallel I'm going to template a consolidation plan to reduce target group usage by 40% if quotas are not increased. I'll paste it to INFRA-1289.

anika_infra: For the immediate unblock, I've moved two onboarding stacks to shared-ALB-01 and patched Terraform to prevent new stacks from creating more than 10 TGs each. Deployment can proceed for AcmeCorp while we wait on quota.

alex_finance: Noted. Keep me posted if the quota approval implies re-architecting any paid service (e.g., extra NAT gateways) — I'll re-evaluate.

jamie_dev: tagging @maria_cloud @alex_finance on INFRA-1289. Closing the loop here — will update thread when AWS responds. :thumbsup:
